title: Chana, Father of Rabbah
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: His son is known as Rabbah bar Chana or Rabbah bar bar Chana. In the Jerusalem Talmud he is called Abba bar Chana. Chana, the father, was the brother of Rabbi Chiyya, and the son of Abba bar Acha bar Salla (or Karsala) of Kafri, as in Sanhedrin 5a.

notes.text: The brother of Rabbi Chiyya and son of Abba bar Acha is Chana, the entry’s father, not Rabbah his son. The William Davidson digital Sanhedrin 5a explicitly lists Chana and Rabbi Chiyya among the children; Hyman’s bar Salla / Karsala forms are retained.
Sanhedrin 5a names Chana and Chiyya among the children of Abba bar Acha Karsala of Kafri. The forms and relationship in the heading are kept as Hyman gives them.
